news.abstract: Health officials hope to soon vaccinate up to two million people per week as the country’s hospitals are overwhelmed by cases of a new, more contagious coronavirus variant.
news.title: U.K. Authorizes Covid-19 Vaccine From Oxford and AstraZeneca

news.abstract: The Senate vote on Wednesday was a major victory for Latin America’s growing feminist movement, and its ripple effects are likely to be widespread.
news.title: Argentina Legalizes Abortion, a Milestone in a Conservative Region

news.abstract: Mr. Pollard, who gave a range of classified documents to Israel starting in 1984, recently completed his parole. His case was a longstanding irritant to American-Israeli ties.
news.title: Jonathan Pollard, Spy for Israel, Gets Hero’s Welcome From Netanyahu: ‘You’re Home’

news.abstract: Although the vast majority of nursing home residents in Ohio are accepting a vaccine for Covid-19, the same cannot be said for the staff in these facilities, Gov. Mike DeWine said on Wednesday.
news.title: Ohio offered nursing home workers early dibs on a vaccine. Many said no.

news.abstract: China has spent heavily to help its poorest citizens, an approach that few developing countries can afford and even Beijing may struggle to sustain.
news.title: Jobs, Houses and Cows: China’s Costly Drive to Erase Extreme Poverty

news.abstract: Even in this dark year, there have been moments of lightness, growth and utter joy.
news.title: Joy survives: Readers share memories of the good moments from this year.

news.abstract: Mr. Lai, the most prominent figure charged under Hong Kong’s sweeping national security law, had been released on bail just days before Thursday’s hearing.
news.title: Jimmy Lai, Hong Kong Pro-Democracy Mogul, Is Ordered Back to Jail

news.abstract: The authorities in India are imposing a night curfew in the capital, New Delhi, restricting celebrations in a metropolis known for hosting grand events on New Year’s Eve after more cases of a new variant of coronavirus were reported across the country.
news.title: India imposes a curfew in New Delhi to curb New Year celebrations.
